claims.text: The Joule is a revitalized neo-Gothic landmark in the center of downtown Dallas.

findings.quote: A revitalized, neo-Gothic landmark in the center of downtown, The Joule is a 160-room urban resort
In the heart of Dallas, we’re here to inspire the mind

claims.text: The hotel is at 1530 Main St. in downtown Dallas.

findings.quote: 1530 Main St., Dallas, Texas 75201
Set in the heart of downtown Dallas

claims.text: All rooms include a mini bar, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, 400-thread-count Kassatex linens, Salt & Stone amenities, a rainfall shower and down pillows and comforter.

findings.quote: All rooms include: mini bar, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen HDTV, 400-thread-count Kassatex linens, spa-like bathrooms, Salt & Stone amenities, rainfall shower, and down pillows and comforter.

claims.text: The Loft Suite is a two-story suite with 20-foot ceilings.

findings.quote: This newly reimagined two-story loft suite offers a modern escape with 20-foot ceilings

claims.text: The Joule Penthouse has a pool table, a private library, a kitchenette and two terraces.

findings.quote: Expansive living and dining areas feature ample seating, pool table, private library, kitchenette, and two terraces for alfresco enjoyment.

claims.text: CBD Provisions is a brasserie that is French in method and Texan in manner, with dishes that celebrate local ingredients.

findings.quote: French in method, Texan in manner, stop in to enjoy longtime favorites and a selection of new dishes crafted to celebrate local ingredients.
Modern brasserie in Downtown

claims.text: Sassetta is an Italian destination restaurant serving breakfast, lunch and dinner daily, with brunch on weekends.

findings.quote: This inviting Italian destination restaurant
Open daily for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, with brunch on weekends.

claims.text: Sassetta's popular dishes include lobster spaghetti and burnt honey pizza.

findings.quote: Sassetta is a popular Italian eatery with popular dishes like lobster spaghetti and burnt honey pizza.

claims.text: Weekend Coffee in the lobby uses beans from Counter Culture.

findings.quote: Latte lovers will swoon for the lobby's Weekend Coffee with beans from Counter Culture.

claims.text: The Mosaic Bar is a lobby bar for a first drink of the night or a nightcap.

findings.quote: The Mosaic Bar is a fitting spot to start your night or wind down with a nightcap. Sip your martini at the bar or grab a cozy nook in the lobby for conversation.

claims.text: Spa treatments include custom facials, holistic body rituals and restorative massages.

findings.quote: Custom facials, holistic body rituals, and restorative massages are among the most sought-after treatments.

claims.text: The 9th-floor Fitness Center has Technogym aerobic and strength-training equipment, free weights, wellness balls and yoga mats.

findings.quote: Located on the 9th floor, our Fitness Center
The space is outfitted with Technogym aerobic and strength-training equipment, free weights, wellness balls, and yoga mats.

claims.text: The rooftop pool is cantilevered, giving swimmers the sensation of swimming out beyond the hotel's edge.

findings.quote: The Joule's unique 8-foot cantilevered pool provides guests the sensation of swimming out beyond the hotel's edge

claims.text: Midnight Rambler is a subterranean cocktail bar reached down a flight of stairs.

findings.quote: Follow the lightning and descend a flight of stairs to be transported to another world in our subterranean cocktail bar.

claims.text: The Spa at The Joule is a subterranean spa with a holistic approach to wellness.

findings.quote: The Spa at The Joule is a subterranean oasis with a holistic approach to wellness.

claims.text: Works by artists including Tony Tasset, Andy Warhol and Millard Sheets are on display, starting in the lobby.

findings.quote: this art-inspired hotel is filled with works from brilliant artists like Tony Tasset, Andy Warhol, Millard Sheets, and more from the moment you walk into the lobby.

claims.text: A giant 30-foot eyeball sculpture stands across the street from the hotel.

findings.quote: check out the giant 30-foot eyeball across the street.
Tony Tasset’s iconic Eye sculpture

claims.text: To use the spa's European heat experiences, plan to arrive about an hour before your treatment.

findings.quote: Come an hour or so before your actual appointment to indulge in the European heat experiences.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack traditional hotel tranquility.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
